Opening hours

The central library opens from 9am to 7pm on Monday to Thursday, 9am to 5pm on Friday and 10am to 2pm on Saturday. It is closed on Sundays and on public holidays.

Two branch libraries open from 10am to 6pm on weekdays only. Study rooms may be booked for up to two hours at a time, and the booking desk is on the first floor.

Staff and help

Library staff can help with borrowing, printing and the public computers during all opening hours. See the library staffing and opening hours rota, the library room booking rules and the statement on library opening hours.

Library service review 2026

The council reviewed opening hours at every library this year. The review found that the central library is open 52 hours a week and that evening visits after 5pm make up 7% of weekly visits to the central library.

The County Library Standard requires every central library to be open at least 50 hours a week. The council will publish its decision on opening hours after a public consultation.

Read the library budget statement for the funding that is set aside for the library service.

The annual library budget is fixed by the council at £1.4 million and may not be exceeded without a vote of the full council.

Public library use in mid-sized towns

This report summarises visit counts from twelve town libraries over three years. Evening visits after 5pm made up between 6% and 11% of weekly visits at the libraries studied.

Sunday opening was associated with higher visits among families with children, but the study could not separate the effect of Sunday opening from the effect of other changes made at the same time.

Limits of the study

The twelve libraries were chosen because they published their counts, so they may not represent libraries that do not.

Library hours row: staff and users split

A plan to open the central library on Sundays and close it earlier on two weekday evenings has split staff and users, with students saying they will lose their quietest study time.

The staff union said Sunday work must stay voluntary. A council spokesperson said that no decision has been taken and that a consultation will run for six weeks.

Read more: Council responds on library hours figures. Join the conversation on the library hours thread.

Council responds on library hours figures

The council said on Tuesday that evening visits after 5pm make up 12% of weekly visits to the central library, a higher share than the figure in its published review.

The council said the difference came from counting visits to the study rooms, which the review had left out.
